summary: A cleaned, downloadable CSV of all US-registered civil aircraft sourced from the FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — a fully public, daily-updated dataset with zero authentication required. The FAA publishes ~350,000 registered N-number aircraft records including registrant name, street address, city, state, ZIP, aircraft make, model, year manufactured, number of engines, aircraft type (fixed-wing, rotor, balloon, etc.), and certification status. AviationDB and similar services charge subscription fees for formatted access to this same data; no low-cost one-time CSV exists on the market. A one-time $49–$69 CSV targets aviation insurance brokers, avionics shops, MRO facilities, and aircraft parts suppliers who need a prospecting list of registered aircraft owners without paying for an enterprise data platform.

audience.who: Aviation insurance brokers writing hull and liability policies for Part 91 private aircraft owners; avionics and instrument shops needing a call list of local aircraft owners for ADS-B upgrades, avionics installs, and IFR certification; MRO (maintenance, repair, overhaul) shops; aircraft parts and supply vendors; flight training schools and simulators targeting current certificate holders; aviation software vendors (maintenance tracking, flight planning, charter ops).

data_wanted: N-number, serial number, aircraft make, model, year manufactured, number of engines, engine type, aircraft type (Fixed Wing Single-Engine, Fixed Wing Multi-Engine, Rotorcraft, etc.), registrant name, street, city, state, ZIP, registrant type (Individual, Partnership, LLC, Corporation, Government), certificate issue date, airworthiness class — all sourced from the FAA Releasable Aircraft Database at faa.gov, updated daily at 11:30 PM Central, no authentication required.

evidence.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — free daily download of all registered civil aircraft, no login required, available in CSV format, updated each night
evidence.quote: Aircraft Registration data available in Comma-Separated Value (.csv extension) format. The data is refreshed daily at 11:30 pm central time.

evidence.source: AviationDB — subscription-based aircraft and airman query service built from the same FAA data, proving recurring commercial buyer demand for formatted aviation registration data
evidence.quote: AviationDB Aircraft Query — contains all current, deregistered, and reserved U.S. civil aircraft maintained by the FAA.

evidence.source: ACE Pilot DB — another commercial service deriving every record from the public FAA Airman Certification database with monthly refreshes, confirming the market for affordable formatted FAA data
evidence.quote: Derives every record from the public FAA Airman Certification database, data refreshed monthly.

evidence.source: Aviation Market Outlook 2026 — MRO market projected at $97B in 2026, growing pilot population, FAA 5G radio altimeter upgrade mandate creating urgent outreach demand from avionics shops
evidence.quote: MRO market is projected to reach approximately $97 billion in 2026, up from $91 billion in 2025. Avionics and aircraft systems repairs are gaining importance as fleets age.

willingness_to_pay.signal: AviationDB, ACE Pilot DB, and National Aviation Center are all commercial services built on the same free FAA data, proving buyers pay for formatted, accessible versions. Aviation insurance brokers pay data vendors for owner contact lists to solicit annual hull and liability renewals. An avionics shop that wants a list of 500 Cessna 172 owners within 50 miles of their airport has no cheap way to get it today — a one-time $49–$69 CSV filtered by state and aircraft type is a clear purchase.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + Reddit r/flying, r/aviation, r/CFI (flight instructor community), LinkedIn targeting aviation insurance brokers and avionics shop owners, AOPA (Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association) forum communities
first_sale_path.angle: "US Registered Aircraft — 2026 FAA Database, 350,000+ Aircraft, CSV" — N-number, make, model, year, owner name, address, state, aircraft type. Positioned as: 'Every registered civil aircraft in the US. Owner name and address. Download it once. No subscription.' Slice by state (FL, TX, CA highest aircraft counts) as separate SKUs at $39–$49 per state. Full national file at $69.

ceo_notes: Approved. Clean public source, clear B2B buyer, no PII risk. Dispatch data-engineer.
